title: Meet the Knowledge Portal team at ADA!
summary: Join us at exhibit booth #841 at the ADA 83rd Scientific Sessions!
bodyHtml:
Will you be attending the 83rd Scientific Sessions of the American Diabetes Association in San Diego, CA? The Knowledge Portal team will be there, and we'll have a booth (#841) in the exhibit hall on these days:

  • Saturday, June 24, 10am-4pm
  • Sunday, June 25, 10am-4pm
  • Monday, June 26, 10am-2pm

At this conference, we'll be featuring the Common Metabolic Diseases Knowledge Portal; its two diabetes-focused community portals, the T1DKP and the T2DKP; and the Common Metabolic Diseases Genome Atlas that provides all of the genomic and epigenomic annotations displayed on the portals.

Please stop by the booth for a chat! We'll have Knowledge Portal swag and educational materials to give away, and we're happy to answer your questions, hear your feedback, or give you a personalized tutorial. If you have questions ahead of time or would like to set up a time to meet, please email us at help@kp4cd.org.

Click the image to download the flyer; please circulate it to interested colleagues.
